_meta.note: Manual price overrides layered on top of the vendored models.dev snapshot. The snapshot lags provider price pages — verified 2026-09-11 against DeepSeek's official rates, where the output price differed by ~4.3x. Overrides exist ONLY for the models this project actually calls; do not mass-sync every model in the snapshot.
_meta.pricing_basis_note: DeepSeek publishes peak and off-peak rates (off-peak is half). Estimates deliberately use the peak rate so a cost estimate never under-reports what the provider may bill.
_meta.checked_by: manual review of the provider price page

deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash.note: Built-in model. Served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; `deepseek-v4-flash` is a legacy alias still accepted and billed at the Flash price. Peak: $0.30 input (cache miss) / $1.20 output / $0.006 cache hit. Off-peak is $0.15 / $0.60 / $0.003. Snapshot previously said $0.14 / $0.28.
